data.content_ref: inline:Allow suspended nodes to be re-examined only through a fresh edge-construction pass that commits new warrants, and make each pass a deterministic polynomial function of the previous graph plus the RESIDUE certificate of the queried node. Bound the number of passes per conjecture by a constant; overall cost remains polynomial, and determinism holds because each pass is a pure function. This unifies SRC_008 with the edge-construction principle: the fixpoint remains the sole decision rule within each pass, and committed roots stay valid because new warrants must themselves be committed before they can relabel a suspended node.
